payload.title: The tenant capability catalogue offers 82 of its 100 resource:action keys that no backend check reads (every farm, batch and operations key, the HR employee, attendance, leave and shift keys, reports, settings and most messaging keys), so a restriction a tenant admin sets in the role editor restricts nothing
evidence: apps/auth-service/src/modules/tenant/services/permission-catalogue.ts:21-59 (farm, batch and operations categories, none read by any guard)
apps/auth-service/src/modules/tenant/services/permission-catalogue.ts:60-80 (HR employee, attendance, leave, shift and reports keys; only hr_finance:view_salary is enforced)
libs/backend-common/src/guards/tenant-permission.guard.ts:73-76 (a capability binds only where a handler names it)
apps/farm-service/src/common/authz/permission-matrix.ts:51 (createBatch decided by global role alone; batches:create is never read)
apps/admin-api-service/src/users/services/role-template.service.ts:46-108 (a second published list with keys such as farms:view and users:create that the catalogue does not contain)
payload.rule_violated: Plan PKG-03 goal (the catalogue holds only enforced keys plus company:view) and the repo hierarchy impossible > detectable: a control offered to a tenant admin must be enforced or must not exist
payload.notes: Program module-boundaries, package PKG-03, release R1.
